findings.reason: .factory/config.yaml:2 does make the test command a no-op echo, but that's factory setup, not part of this change. The diff only swaps the local assign helper for Object.assign at index.js:15. Object.assign also skips an undefined opts.configuration and copies own enumerable keys onto a fresh object, and package.json:45 requires node >=6, so the behaviour is the same and the change isn't broken.
findings.claim: The factory test command never runs the project suite, so no test run shows the assign→Object.assign swap is safe.
findings.evidence: The test command is `echo 'replay: the project suite is not run; see factory/replay.py' && exit 0`, so it always exits 0. The diff changes index.js:15 from the local `assign(defaults, configuration)` helper to `Object.assign(...)` and deletes the helper. I read the code and the two look behaviourally equivalent on the declared engine `"node": ">=6"` (both skip a null or undefined `opts.configuration`, and both copy own enumerable keys with plain assignment). That equivalence is from reading the code only: no test run backs it.
